name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.CreateAppProfile
notes: App profiles must route to existing clusters and carry etags; a default single-cluster transactional profile is created with each instance.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.CreateCluster
notes: Cluster IDs are validated, serve_nodes/autoscaling/node_scaling_factor are stored, and DeleteCluster is blocked for the last cluster, for clusters holding backups and for clusters referenced by app-profile routing.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.CreateInstance
notes: Instances need a 6-33 character ID and at least one cluster; non-empty display names 4-30 characters (empty create names default to the instance ID); PartialUpdateInstance supports display_name/labels/type/edition and rejects PRODUCTION->DEVELOPMENT; deletion is blocked by protected resources or backups and cascades otherwise.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.CreateLogicalView
notes: Logical-view descriptors support CRUD, etags, deletion protection, parent-scoped pagination and typed LRO metadata; the query is validated and executed by the GoogleSQL engine (always built).

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.CreateMaterializedView
notes: Continuous materialized views are defined in GoogleSQL (GROUP BY or ORDER BY), populated at creation, refreshed before reads after source writes, read-only, persisted, deletion protected and immutable except for deletion_protection.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.DeleteAppProfile
notes: App profiles must route to existing clusters and carry etags; a default single-cluster transactional profile is created with each instance.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.DeleteCluster

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.DeleteInstance

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.DeleteLogicalView

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.DeleteMaterializedView

name: BigtableTableAdmin.CheckConsistency
notes: Tokens are validated per table and are always consistent because there is a single local replica.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.CopyBackup
notes: CopyBackup requires a READY source that is not itself a copy, always produces a STANDARD backup, and limits expire_time to 6h..30d from the request; a source expiring within 24h is FailedPrecondition.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.CreateAuthorizedView
notes: CRUD with etags (ABORTED on mismatch), NAME_ONLY/BASIC/FULL views, pagination, subset_view/deletion_protection masks and typed LRO metadata; data RPCs through a view are restricted to its row prefixes and family subsets.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.CreateBackup
notes: Backups are immutable schema and row snapshots: expire_time 6h..90d (365d for Enterprise Plus), HOT/STANDARD rules, per-table limits, copy rules (no copy of a copy, <= 30 days after source creation) and restore into a new table without inheriting GC policies.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.CreateSchemaBundle
notes: Proto (FileDescriptorSet) and Avro (JSON) bundles with validation, 10 per table, 4MB, immutable oneof structure, backward-compatibility checks overridable by ignore_warnings, etags and pagination.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.CreateTable
notes: CreateTable validates IDs, GC rules (max_age >= 1ms, <= 500 bytes), aggregate value types, change-stream retention and row-key schemas, and persists initial splits; GetTable/ListTables honor views and pagination.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.DeleteAuthorizedView
notes: Updates honor update_mask (empty = fields set in the request, '*' = all) and etags; deletes honor etags and deletion protection.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.DeleteBackup
notes: CopyBackup requires a READY source that is not itself a copy, always produces a STANDARD backup, and limits expire_time to 6h..30d from the request; a source expiring within 24h is FailedPrecondition.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.DeleteSchemaBundle
notes: Proto (FileDescriptorSet) and Avro (JSON) bundles with validation, 10 per table, 4MB, immutable oneof structure, backward-compatibility checks overridable by ignore_warnings, etags and pagination.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.DeleteTable
notes: DeleteTable is blocked by table/authorized-view deletion protection and soft-deletes the table; UndeleteTable restores data within 7 days, enables deletion protection, and is AlreadyExists when a live table with the same ID exists.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.DropRowRange
notes: Deletes by prefix or the whole table in one transaction, recording DeleteFromFamily change records when change streams are enabled.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.GenerateConsistencyToken
notes: Tokens are validated per table and are always consistent because there is a single local replica.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.GetAuthorizedView
notes: CRUD with etags (ABORTED on mismatch), NAME_ONLY/BASIC/FULL views, pagination, subset_view/deletion_protection masks and typed LRO metadata; data RPCs through a view are restricted to its row prefixes and family subsets.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.GetBackup
notes: Expired backups are invisible to Get/List/Copy/Restore/Update and are purged by maintenance with their manifests and snapshot rows.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.GetIamPolicy
notes: Policies persist with etags and update_mask, require existing resources and are removed with the table.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.GetSchemaBundle
notes: Proto (FileDescriptorSet) and Avro (JSON) bundles with validation, 10 per table, 4MB, immutable oneof structure, backward-compatibility checks overridable by ignore_warnings, etags and pagination.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.GetTable
notes: GetTable defaults to SCHEMA_VIEW and supports NAME_ONLY, REPLICATION_VIEW and ENCRYPTION_VIEW (one READY cluster, GOOGLE_DEFAULT_ENCRYPTION) and FULL.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.ListAuthorizedViews
notes: CRUD with etags (ABORTED on mismatch), NAME_ONLY/BASIC/FULL views, pagination, subset_view/deletion_protection masks and typed LRO metadata; data RPCs through a view are restricted to its row prefixes and family subsets.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.ListBackups
notes: ListBackups supports the '-' cluster wildcard, filters (name, source_table, state, backup_type, source_backup, times, size_bytes with comparison operators and AND), single-field order_by (default start_time desc) and pagination.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.ListSchemaBundles
notes: ListSchemaBundles paginates per table with stable tokens.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.ListTables
notes: ListTables defaults to NAME_ONLY, supports SCHEMA_VIEW, and paginates with stable tokens; invalid tokens are InvalidArgument.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.ModifyColumnFamilies
notes: All modifications are validated before any is applied; per-modification update_mask supports gc_rule, value_type is immutable, and dropping a family physically removes its data.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.RestoreTable
notes: RestoreTable creates a new table from the backup snapshot, independent of the live source, with RestoreInfo and an OptimizeRestoredTable operation; GC policies, automated backup policy and deletion protection are not inherited.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.SetIamPolicy
notes: Policies persist with etags and update_mask, require existing resources and are removed with the table.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.TestIamPermissions
notes: Policies persist with etags and update_mask, require existing resources and are removed with the table.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.UndeleteTable
notes: DeleteTable is blocked by table/authorized-view deletion protection and soft-deletes the table; UndeleteTable restores data within 7 days, enables deletion protection, and is AlreadyExists when a live table with the same ID exists.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.UpdateAuthorizedView
notes: Updates honor update_mask (empty = fields set in the request, '*' = all) and etags; deletes honor etags and deletion protection.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.UpdateBackup
notes: UpdateBackup validates expire_time with the create rules and allows hot_to_standard_time changes only on HOT backups; backup_type is immutable.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.UpdateSchemaBundle
notes: Proto (FileDescriptorSet) and Avro (JSON) bundles with validation, 10 per table, 4MB, immutable oneof structure, backward-compatibility checks overridable by ignore_warnings, etags and pagination.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.UpdateTable
notes: Supported mask paths (change_stream_config[.retention_period], deletion_protection, row_key_schema, automated_backup_policy[.*], tiered_storage_config) persist across restart and return an UpdateTableMetadata LRO; column_families is Unimplemented and '*' is InvalidArgument; disabling the change stream purges its records.

name: Bigtable.CheckAndMutateRow
notes: The predicate is evaluated on the (view-restricted) row and only the chosen branch is validated and applied atomically; transactional routing is required for registered app profiles.

name: Bigtable.ExecuteQuery
notes: GoogleSQL for Bigtable queries are parsed, type-checked and executed by the local engine; prepared queries are self-describing and report PREPARED_QUERY_EXPIRED after schema changes.

name: Bigtable.GenerateInitialChangeStreamPartitions
notes: Tables with change_stream_config expose one full-keyspace partition (single local tablet); tables without it are FailedPrecondition.

name: Bigtable.MutateRow
notes: All mutations are validated before any is applied; a failing request leaves the row and the change stream untouched.

name: Bigtable.MutateRows
notes: Entries commit in one transaction with per-entry statuses: invalid entries report their own code and are not applied, valid entries are applied, and duplicate row keys in one batch apply in request order.

name: Bigtable.PingAndWarm
notes: Validates the instance name, the instance when strict admin mode is on, and the app profile; there is no distributed metadata cache to warm, so success is a no-op.

name: Bigtable.PrepareQuery
notes: GoogleSQL for Bigtable queries are parsed, type-checked and executed by the local engine; prepared queries are self-describing and report PREPARED_QUERY_EXPIRED after schema changes.

name: Bigtable.ReadChangeStream
notes: Records come from a transactional outbox written with each row commit: one DataChange per commit with grouped chunks, USER and GARBAGE_COLLECTION types, DeleteFromRow expanded to DeleteFromFamily per family, opaque continuation tokens, heartbeats with low watermarks, retention-checked start_time and CloseStream OK at end_time.

name: Bigtable.ReadModifyWriteRow
notes: All rules are validated before any is applied; increments require 8-byte big-endian values (FailedPrecondition otherwise) and aggregate families are rejected with InvalidArgument.

name: Bigtable.SampleRowKeys
notes: SampleRowKeys honors row_range and returns the table's initial split keys plus one sample every 512KiB of stored data, ending with the range end key or the empty end-of-table key carrying the total offset.

name: Operations.GetOperation
notes: Every LRO-returning admin RPC registers a durable operation (operations/<resource>/locations/local/operations/<n>) with its documented metadata type.

name: Operations.ListOperations
notes: ListOperations filters by name prefix and done=true| false, paginates, rejects other filters and answers return_partial_success with Unimplemented.

name: Operations.WaitOperation
notes: Wait returns the completed operation immediately, Delete removes it, and Cancel is a no-op for done operations.

name: ReadRowsRequest.table_name

name: ReadRowsRequest.rows
notes: Table targets and row sets with overlapping keys and ranges are merged and de-duplicated in key order.

name: ReadRowsRequest.filter
notes: Filters are validated before reading and evaluated without mutating stored data, including Interleave duplicates, Sink, ValueBitmask and label rules.

name: ReadRowsRequest.rows_limit
notes: Negative rows_limit is InvalidArgument; reversed scans return rows in descending order and honor the limit.

name: ReadRowsRequest.reversed
notes: Negative rows_limit is InvalidArgument; reversed scans return rows in descending order and honor the limit.

name: ReadRowsRequest.request_stats_view

name: ReadRowsRequest.authorized_view_name

name: ReadRowsRequest.app_profile_id

name: ReadRowsRequest.materialized_view_name
notes: materialized_view_name reads the view's derived rows after bringing the view up to date.

name: SampleRowKeysRequest.row_range

name: SampleRowKeysRequest.app_profile_id

name: SampleRowKeysRequest.materialized_view_name
notes: materialized_view_name reads the view's derived rows after bringing the view up to date.

notes: Mutations are validated as a unit and applied atomically to the target row.

notes: Mutations are validated as a unit and applied atomically to the target row.

name: MutateRowRequest.app_profile_id

name: MutateRowsRequest.entries
notes: Entries are validated and applied independently with per-entry status codes in one transaction.

name: MutateRowsRequest.authorized_view_name

name: MutateRowsRequest.app_profile_id
